blocks.html:
Nusens Van Decals

Nusens has been coming to us at Vinyl Wrap Toronto for almost 2 years and has got all their vehicles wrapped with us in that time. We have built up a great working relationship with them and have not just wrapped vehicles and trucks. We have wrapped equipment, Christmas Gifts, and a Skid Loader. This Nusens Decals Vehicle is one of many we have done as you can see in the picture.

More wraps and Decals:

Click here to view more of our equipment wraps. This Nusens Ford Transit arrived with us from just having a fresh paint job and we could not wait to get our hands on it to brand it with Nusens logos. The old logos had to be removed and the van was sent to be repainted.

The plan was to replicate a previous van wrap with the addition of doing the roof as well. The client, Nusens, wanted the vehicle to still be recognizable in the Downtown corridor of Toronto from the high-rise buildings. Our installation crew has done roofs on this type of van before and always says that this is the trickiest part of a vinyl wrap.

We cannot put a person’s body weight onto the roof without doing damage to the vehicle. So, we must install the graphics carefully and not put too much weight on any point of the roof. Nusens has already said to us at Vinyl Wrap Toronto that they have more vehicles on order and would like us to add stickers to each van when they arrive.

If you would like to view more of our installs, Like our Facebook page, Follow us on Instagram, Heart us on Twitter and add a Comment on Pinterest. Speak to our in-house design team if you have any questions at 416-746-1381
